note: AR-020 — the allowlist of the physical utilities that are deliberate. Every entry is a place where a physical edge is the CORRECT answer, and the reason says why. The list may only shrink: the gate fails on an entry that no longer occurs.

reasons.src/components/ui/dialog.tsx: the dialog is CENTRED (`left-[50%] translate-x-[-50%]`) — a centred element has no logical edge to convert to
reasons.src/components/ui/sheet.tsx: the sheet's SIDE is chosen by the caller (`side="right" | "left"`), not by the direction; the panel and its inner border follow that choice
reasons.src/components/ui/sidebar.tsx: the off-canvas rail is keyed to `data-side` — it slides out from the side the sidebar is docked to, which the shell decides
reasons.src/features/analytics/components/analyt: a NUMERIC column: the value is right-aligned and tabular in both directions, so the column reads the same way
reasons.src/features/dashboard/components/creati: a NUMERIC column (`text-right tabular-nums`) — the counts read the same way in both directions
reasons.src/features/trends/components/trends-co: a NUMERIC column (the score and the growth rate) — the numbers read the same way in both directions
